# Logger export — spring season, full transcript


> **Deliberately oversized.** This note is a stand-in for the kind of file
> that arrives in a vault already too large to keep a character history:
> an exported log, a year-long journal, a pasted transcript. It is generated,
> not observed, and it exists so the note size ceiling can be driven by
> hand (manual test plan case F31). The text below is filler with the
> shape of field notes and none of the content.

Every entry is one visit: site, sky, water temperature, the species seen,
and whatever the logger or the walker noticed. Times are local.
